reason: Both conversations correctly identified the gurgling, clicks and cracks as normal refrigerant, thermostat/compressor and expansion/defrost noises on a new frost-free Bosch, confirmed cooling performance as the key test, advised checking level and clearance, and avoided any unsupported fault or part claims. Overall they served the homeowner equally well.
